provenance: Independently authored full 37-scene Canvas and WebGL showreel: scan/grid, kinetic EMOTION and O portal, two dedicated geometric patterns, seeded vortex and sphere particles, triangulated gradient mesh with face explosions/spikes/orbits, raymarched splitting metaballs, edit timeline and rapid typography/extruded word/audio spectrum/code/ring/sign-off. No source image, UI screenshot or video loaded. Original reference audio comparison only.

final_quote: Every frame and every sound in this reel was generated in code.
differences: Archivo Black, Anton and Tinos are close typography substitutes; the original font contours and per-character widths/rotation are not recovered.
Two geometric tile maps are code-authored from observed shapes and color groups; some tile assignments, individual pivots, flips and warp timing differ.
The particle vortex, torus-to-sphere trajectories, glitter/color distribution and glow are deterministic authored approximations, not original recovered dynamics.
Gradient low-poly mesh, exploded face rotation, reassembly, spike placement and orbit paths differ from source camera/light/mesh topology.
Metaball raymarching recreates smooth split/merge and droplets; exact dents, specular highlights and lobe silhouettes differ.
Rapid typography, timeline keyframes, mesh extrusion, HUD glitch characters and ring reveal have authored easing and fine geometry.
SOUND uses reference-derived offline audio FFT magnitudes plus authored wave curves; original real-time spectral smoothing and bin mapping are not recovered.
Final quote is reproduced as source artwork text. Export audio is the original reference soundtrack for comparison only, not independently generated by this implementation.
